card.title: Nintendo Wii An Error Has Occurred... when entering or exiting system apps (such as Mii Channel)

source.title: Nintendo Wii An Error Has Occurred... when entering or exiting system apps (such as Mii Channel)

symptoms: An Error Has Occurred entering/exiting system apps

claims.statement: Wii 'An Error Has Occurred' in system apps like the Mii Channel: disc drive disconnected/dead, or bad homebrew—reinstall default IOS36, IOS58 and IOS80 via NUS Downloader.

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
